desc:
Become the owner of a neighborhood BBQ restaurant filled with the aroma of grilled meat!

Seat your customers, grill the meat, serve them, and even do the dishes. Grow your small shop into a four-story building and a five-story banquet hall.

[NEW] 5th Floor Ballroom Major Update!
- 5th Floor Banquet Hall Opening: Host wedding receptions, baseball team parties, and group tours for foreign tourists
- Gourmet undercover review: The secret review team gives stars. Display the alley gourmet stars on your shop wall.
- 15 Ultra-Rare Employees: Legendary staff members surrounded by auras make a dazzling appearance in the park
- Underground Warehouse: Vault, Display Room, Aging Room. Age kimchi, gochujang, and doenjang to fill your food encyclopedia.
- Store Decoration: Decoration set, rooftop area, wall decorations, light brightness, string lights, karaoke machine, aquarium floor
- Structures above the signboard: Giant griddle, golden pig, Hahoe mask
- Two-seater motorcycle, taser gun, shovel
